generations.zh: 当前代线：XS-2.1（33B 总参 / 3B 激活，262,144 token 上下文）、S-2.1、M.1 等在官方 org 在册；官方 README 称 XS 2.1 相对 XS.2 在 SWE-bench Multilingual +5.4%（厂商自评口径）。
generations.en: Current line: XS-2.1 (33B total / 3B active, 262,144-token context), S-2.1, M.1 and more in the official org; the README claims XS 2.1 gains +5.4% over XS.2 on SWE-bench Multilingual (vendor-run wording).

licenses.zh: OpenMDW-1.1（官方 README：「a fully permissive license. Use it, modify it, and build commercial products on it. No permission required.」）
licenses.en: OpenMDW-1.1 (official README: "a fully permissive license. Use it, modify it, and build commercial products on it. No permission required.")

claims.zh: 官方 README：「33B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 3B activated parameters per token designed for agentic coding and long-horizon work on a local machine」「Context window: 262,144 tokens」；Ollama 与 llama.cpp 官方收录。
claims.en: Official README: "33B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 3B activated parameters per token designed for agentic coding and long-horizon work on a local machine"; "Context window: 262,144 tokens"; listed in Ollama and llama.cpp.

positioning.zh: 代码专用家族里许可最宽的一族（OpenMDW-1.1 完全宽松）；主打「本地机器跑 agentic coding」，激活 3B 是它的本地性来源。本站收录 Laguna XS-2.1 的量化对比。
positioning.en: The most permissively licensed coding line (OpenMDW-1.1, fully permissive); its pitch is agentic coding on a local machine, with 3B active parameters as the source of that locality. This site covers Laguna XS-2.1 quantisations.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 Laguna XS-2.1 的量化对比
onSite.en: This site covers Laguna XS-2.1 quantisations
